title: Yummy American Puy Lentils Stew
description: A hearty, umami-packed stew featuring fluffy puy lentils, perfect as a hangover cure and low-glycemic comfort food. The dish is packed with vegetables and a savory broth that soothes the soul.
instructions: In a medium pot, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté diced onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to deepen the flavor.
Pour in low-sodium vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Rinse 1 cup puy lentils under cold water, then add them to the pot along with dried thyme and a bay leaf.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until lentils are tender and the stew has thickened.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt and pepper to taste, and stir to combine.
Let the stew sit for a few minutes to thicken further before serving.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley if desired, and serve hot.
